full_prompt_en: A square comic painting shows a large blue-skinned man seated with his knees raised, holding a curved tobacco pipe against a pale, lightly sketched stone background. The off-white setting contains faint vertical masonry lines and cool gray wash, leaving the figure much more complete than the space around him. His head fills the upper center, framed by a red cap with round goggles perched on top. Heavy brows, a square nose, dark eyes, broad cheekbones, and pale white sideburns lead down to a pointed beard. He looks slightly upward and left with a guarded, thoughtful expression. A slim pipe stem crosses his mouth toward the right, where his large blue hand holds the reddish-brown bowl close to his face. Wisps of smoke curl upward in pale gray lines. A weathered tan coat with a bright red inner collar drapes over his wide shoulders, its seams and folds built from quick dark contours and loose blue-gray shading. His other hand hangs over the near knee at the lower center. The red trousers spread across both lower corners, with brown boot tops partly visible at the bottom. Broad angular shadow planes give the blue face, neck, and hands weight, while crosshatched and scratched marks keep the color from looking polished. Soft diffuse light from upper left catches the brow, white beard, coat shoulders, and knees; darker blue shadows settle under the jaw and between the arms. The overall composition is a close, grounded character study, balancing saturated red against slate blue skin and tan cloth within an intentionally spare, sketchlike environment.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形漫画绘画描绘一名身形宽大的蓝皮肤男子曲起双膝坐着，在浅色、轻描的石墙背景前拿着弯曲烟斗。灰白环境只有模糊的竖向砌石线和冷灰薄涂，人物完成度远高于周围空间。头部占据上方中央，戴红色帽子，圆形护目镜架在帽顶。浓眉、方鼻、深色眼睛、宽颧骨和浅白鬓毛向下连到尖须。他略微朝左上方看，神情警惕而沉思。细烟斗柄从嘴边伸向右侧，他宽大的蓝色手掌把红棕色斗钵举到脸旁；淡灰烟丝向上卷起。风化棕褐色大衣披在宽肩上，内侧是鲜红衣领；缝线与衣褶由快速深色轮廓和松散蓝灰阴影构成。另一只手垂在下方中央靠近观者的膝上。红色长裤铺开到两个下角，棕色靴筒部分露在底边。宽阔棱角阴影面让蓝色脸、颈和手有重量，交叉排线与刮擦笔迹让色彩不显得过分光洁。左上方柔光照亮眉骨、白须、衣肩和膝盖，较深蓝影落在下颌下与双臂之间。整体构图是一幅近距离、稳重的人物习作，以饱和红色平衡石板蓝皮肤与棕布，放在有意简省的草绘环境里。
style_prompt_en: The comic-painted surface combines firm anatomical contours with transparent wash, rough hatching, and unfinished background lines. Saturated crimson and muted tan sit against cool slate blue and warm off-white, making a few broad color areas carry the image. Angular shadow planes provide volume, while fine scratchy marks texture the flatter passages. Some edges are decisively inked; others trail into faint construction drawing or pale wash. Diffuse upper light produces moderate highlights and concentrated recess shadows instead of a glossy finish. Close foreground masses press against a sparse, lightly indicated ground, emphasizing shape and gesture. The overall effect is muscular yet sketchlike, with comic clarity softened by visible handwork.
style_prompt_zh: 这种漫画式绘画把坚实的人体轮廓与透明薄涂、粗糙排线和未完成背景线结合。饱和深红与低调棕褐立于冷石板蓝和暖灰白之间，让少数宽阔色块承担整幅画面。棱角阴影面塑造体积，细碎刮线为较平坦笔段增添肌理。有些边缘由墨线果断勾出，另一些则拖入淡草线或浅色薄涂。上方漫射光带来适中高光与集中在凹处的阴影，而非油亮表面。近处大体块挤向简略提示的背景，凸显形状与姿态。整体效果有力量却仍像草绘，漫画般清晰度被可见手工笔迹软化。
theme_en: A blue-skinned man in a red cap holding a pipe
theme_zh: 戴红帽、手持烟斗的蓝皮肤男子
name: Stuart Immonen
